text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Cinderella shall be
smashed, blasted, and blown to smithereens!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
More beautiful than Cinderella is none other than I!
TM Opera O!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No way~……
Prince, you are so incredibly beautiful~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O claimed a merciless victory
over Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if she acts like a prince,
when the time comes, she bares her fangs as the 'Conqueror'.
It was very like her, in a way.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Auu... I'm so sorry...
Even though you went out of your way to pick me, I was no match for you...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Right at the very, very end,
I ended up thinking 'someone like me' after all..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, she can't push herself for the sake of egoism.
Is that Doto's weakness...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Then Doto, do your best for my sake!
Grow stronger, and spur me on to greater heights!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: For Opera O-san's sake?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you want to be my lifelong rival, don't you?
In that case...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Lose yourself and strike without hesitation!
Just like those around you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking around, the Umamusume who had run alongside her
were glaring with murderous eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even T.M. Opera O seemed to have realized.
That she was the one
being marked the whole time."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The look on everyone's faces... The look in their eyes...
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I can become like that too. Able to stare down Opera O-san like that.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto. As I declared, my next step
forward shall be to the 'Japan Cup.'

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Think carefully until then. Consider whether
you truly want to become my lifelong rival or not.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without sparing a single glance at the glaring
Umamusume, T.M. Opera O departed the track.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, Doto still has areas to work on,
but so do we, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Though I won against Doto... in my subjective view,
today's run was lacking that final touch. The reason being—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "...Just as expected. I really can't hide anything from you."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With them marking me so strictly,
it's becoming quite difficult to run
like a true "Overlord"...
choice_data_list: But you have no intention of giving up, do you?
But you're not giving up, are you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, so you saw right through that too. Of course.
The path a king charges through—the royal road—is bound to be fraught with hardship!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: As the "Supreme King," one must be a figure capable of overcoming such walls.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let us deliberate before autumn. Together,
we will surely overcome this hardship, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "And at the Japan Cup, let us show the world a performance befitting the monarch of this country!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Overlord Encirclement" Grass Wonder spoke of
had finally become a tangible threat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To establish a dynasty—we must somehow find a way to break through the encirclement.
